title: Battle of Dagupan
text: The Battle of Dagupan was fought on June 2, 1898, between the Philippine rebel forces and Spanish and loyalist forces. It took place in Dagupan in the province of Pangasinan in the Philippines during the Philippine Revolution. Filipino forces won a victory in this battle in which an entire Spanish army, fighting in a last stand, ceased to exist. It resulted to all of Pangasinan being controlled by the Philippine revolutionary government.
